page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-8 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 63.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core, positioning the instance for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration.

The instance does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a high memory-to-vCPU ratio provides a balanced resource density for workloads requiring substantial memory overhead without the cost of high-core-count configurations.

Appropriate workloads for the c4d-highmem-8 include relational databases, caching layers, in-memory data processing, enterprise applications, and mid-sized web serving environments where memory capacity is a primary bottleneck.
